# AIPerf

> Python 3.10+ async AI benchmarking tool for measuring LLM inference server performance. Services communicate via ZMQ message bus; optionally deployable on Kubernetes via a kopf-based operator.

AIPerf drives synthetic load against LLM-serving endpoints (OpenAI-compatible chat/completions, embeddings, rankings, image/audio, etc.), collects per-request telemetry, and emits latency / throughput / token-rate / goodput metrics. It runs as a local multi-process pipeline or as a Kubernetes Custom Resource (`AIPerfJob`) managed by a kopf-based operator. Inter-service communication uses a ZMQ message bus with Pydantic-modeled messages for control traffic and tagged `msgspec.Struct` payloads for hot-path wire formats.

Agents working in this repo should read `CLAUDE.md` first — it defines coding standards, build/test commands, and the three-file-sync rule that keeps Claude, Copilot, and Cursor on the same conventions. Then consult the docs below as the task requires.

## Agent bootstrap

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Coding standards, build/test commands, pre-commit hooks, per-subsystem conventions, LLM-ergonomics floor/ceiling. Kept identical to `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and `.cursor/rules/python.mdc` by the three-file-sync rule.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Dev setup, available `make` targets, DCO sign-off, contribution workflow.
- [README.md](README.md): Install, quickstart, tutorial index.

## Architecture and patterns

- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): Three-plane architecture (control, data, observability), core components, credit system, data flow, communication patterns.
- [docs/dev/patterns.md](docs/dev/patterns.md): Canonical code patterns with reference-file paths — CLI commands, services, models, messages, plugins, kopf handlers, FastAPI routers, error handling, logging, testing, plus LLM-ergonomics exemplars. Grep this file first when adding a new piece of code.
- [docs/dev/kubernetes-flow.md](docs/dev/kubernetes-flow.md): Operator/CR lifecycle, kopf handler module split, `aiperf kube` CLI flow.

## Reference

- [docs/cli-options.md](docs/cli-options.md): Auto-generated CLI command and option reference. Regenerate with `make generate-cli-docs` — do not edit by hand.
- [docs/environment-variables.md](docs/environment-variables.md): Auto-generated `AIPERF_*` environment variable reference. Regenerate with `make generate-env-vars-docs` — do not edit by hand.
- [docs/metrics-reference.md](docs/metrics-reference.md): Metric definitions, formulas, and requirements.
- [docs/plugins/plugin-system.md](docs/plugins/plugin-system.md): Plugin architecture, categories (endpoint, dataset, grader, ui, service, ...), YAML registry format, creation guide.
- [docs/plugins/creating-your-first-plugin.md](docs/plugins/creating-your-first-plugin.md): End-to-end plugin walkthrough.
- [docs/reference/](docs/reference/): Tokenizer and other reference material.
